feature.title: Synchronized Chronometers
feature.description: Users receive a ready-to-use set of chronometers without configuring each one. A single action starts the full set together, making group timing quick and consistent.
feature.context: The new timing application has no chronometer experience yet, so this establishes its first focused interaction.

stories.title: Create and start synchronized chronometers
stories.description: As a timing operator, I want a ready-made set of chronometers that starts together so that I can time a group consistently.
acceptance_criteria: Initialization displays between 5 and 10 chronometers, inclusive.
Every displayed chronometer initially shows 00:00.000 and is stopped.
Activating Start begins every displayed chronometer in the same user action.
Running chronometers show no visible sequencing caused by startup order.
Start becomes disabled while all chronometers are running.
Running times use mm:ss.mmm formatting and refresh once per second.
In-app navigation preserves the set until a full browser refresh.
The Start control has an accessible name and works with a keyboard.
An initialization failure presents a clear error instead of a partial set.
